# PageHeader

PageHeader: a page's title row, with an optional breadcrumb trail above it, actions to its side, and a bottom bar below.

Also asked as: heading with buttons, header actions, page heading.

**Import:** `import { PageHeader } from '@/components';`

**Source:** `design-system/src/components/layout-and-structure/PageHeader/PageHeader.jsx`

**Stories:** `design-system/src/components/layout-and-structure/PageHeader/PageHeader.stories.jsx` — Basic, WithBreadcrumbsActionsAndBottomBar, DisableTitleStyles, Interactive, Rest, Hovered, Pressed, Focused

**Storybook page:** `design-system/src/components/layout-and-structure/PageHeader/PageHeader.mdx`

## Usage

Use `PageHeader` once per page, at the top of the Page pattern's body, to
carry the page's title and the actions that apply to the page as a whole. For
a heading inside a region of the page, use the
Section
pattern's own header instead — `PageHeader` is reserved for the page level.

## Best practices

### Show the trail on nested pages. {#show-the-trail-on-nested-pages}

Breadcrumbs tell the person where they are; on a page two levels down they are the way back.

Do: Breadcrumbs on a nested page.
Don't: Nested page with no way back.

### Name the page in a word or two. {#name-the-page-in-a-word-or-two}

The title shares a row with actions, so it has to stay on one line.

Do: A short noun.
Don't: A title that wraps and pushes actions down.

### Use only the parts the page needs. {#use-only-the-parts-the-page-needs}

Every extra row pushes content down; add a part only when the page uses it.

Do: Title and one action.
Don't: Breadcrumbs, actions and bottom bar all on.

### `title` or `children` — not both. {#title-or-children-not-both}

Pass the title through `title`, or through `children` when that reads more
naturally in the surrounding code; `children` is only used when `title` is
not given.

```jsx
<PageHeader
    title="Session plans"
    breadcrumbs={<Breadcrumb items={trail} />}
    actions={<Button text="New plan" />}
/>
```

### Reach for `disableTitleStyles` only when the title isn't plain text. {#reach-for-disabletitlestyles-only-when-the-title-isn-t-plain-text}

The default renders the title in a `Heading`. Turn styling off when the
title itself needs to be something other than text that a `Heading` can
wrap — a custom element already carrying its own heading semantics.

## Accessibility

- **A real heading.** The title renders as an `h2` by default, giving the
  page one clear entry point for assistive technology navigating by
  heading.
- **Breadcrumbs keep their own semantics.** `PageHeader` doesn't wrap
  `breadcrumbs` in extra markup — pass a `Breadcrumb` component, which
  carries its own navigation landmark.

## Related

- For a heading inside a region of the page, use the Section pattern.
- For the trail shown above the title, use `Breadcrumb`.

Same group: `Accordion` · `Carousel` · `Panel` · `ScrollBar`

## Parts

1. **Breadcrumbs.** Optional, above the title.
2. **Title.** A level 2 heading, or any node with `disableTitleStyles`.
3. **Actions.** Optional, at the end of the title row.
4. **Bottom bar.** Optional, under the row: tabs, a filter bar or a status line.

### States

| State | What changes |
| --- | --- |
| Rest | A title row with its actions, no ground of its own. |
| Hovered | Nothing changes. Hover belongs to the breadcrumbs, actions and tabs inside. |
| Pressed | Nothing changes. |
| Focused | Not focusable. Focus goes to the controls in the slots. |
| Disabled | A header has no disabled state. Disable the controls in it. |

### Tokens

| Part | Token |
| --- | --- |
| Title | `Heading` at the `xlarge` size, as an `h2`. |
| Rows | `--space-100` between breadcrumbs, title row and bottom bar. |
| Title row | `--space-150` between the title and its actions; `--space-075` between actions. |
| Breadcrumbs | `--body-small`. |

## Content guidelines

| Do | Don't |
| --- | --- |
| Name the page for what a person does or sees: "Session plans". | Use the product name or "Page" as the title. |
| Keep the title to a few words. | Write a sentence with a verb and a full stop. |
| Put the one main action first in the actions. | Fill the actions with every command the page has. |

## Props

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|------|------|---------|-------------|
| `title` | node | — | The page title. Drawn as an `xlarge` `Heading` unless `disableTitleStyles` is set. `children` is used when it is omitted. |
| `children` | node | — | `children` is the title when `title` is not given. |
| `breadcrumbs` | node | — | A breadcrumb trail shown above the title row. Pass a `Breadcrumb`. |
| `actions` | node | — | Controls shown at the end of the title row, such as a primary button or a menu. |
| `bottomBar` | node | — | Content in a bar below the title row, such as tabs or filters. |
| `disableTitleStyles` | bool | `false` | Renders the title as a plain node instead of a `Heading`, for a caller that styles it itself. |
| `className` | string | — | Extra class names added to the header element beside the component's own. |
